name: Disable ad & telemetry daemons
description: 1.2.0 stops masking slive-provider-daemon (Type=dbus, BusName=com.samsung.FCCallListener) and com.samsung.tv.context-aware-service (Type=dbus, BusName=org.tizen.tv.contextaware2), plus their .busname/.path triggers and opt-out switches: masking a unit that owns a D-Bus name leaves callers waiting for an owner that can never appear, the same measured mechanism that put a 2-3 s dead zone behind every remote key press when data-service was masked (see samsung-telemetry-off 1.4.0). It unmasks and starts both on apply so an upgrade heals without a reboot. 1.1.0 added the other two members of the contents-analysis stack (ui-detector, cognition manager) and the .path/.socket activation triggers, so the daemons no longer have a watcher re-arming them. Masks and stops Samsung's ad/telemetry daemons (adagent/pisa, canalysis, contents recognition, context-aware agent, cis) at every boot.
author: levkropp
